The JSON Root renders a full calendar. Pass value as a date range with start and end, and read the encoded range from valueChange. For a custom native grid, use the children snippet of a Bits UI RangeCalendar root and supply the scoped month and day values to the native parts.

## Usage

```ts
import { rangeCalendar, components } from '@viewstem/svelte-ui/shadcn/range-calendar';
```

The set ID is `shadcn/range-calendar`. It [registers](../../registration/) 1 component for use in JSON.

## JSON reference

Inputs without **Required** are optional. In a type, `?` marks an optional object field. **Default** shows a literal default declared by the Svelte wrapper. Other defaults are unspecified here and may come from the underlying component, the browser, or other inputs.

<a id="native-context"></a>

## Parts that require native context

Use these exports in Svelte. This set provides them as native components without JSON adapter registration.

| Catalog part | Native exports | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Caption` | `components.Caption` | Formats the current month or renders month and year selects. Pass the scoped month DateValue and a bound placeholder for navigation. |
| `Cell` | `components.Cell` | Wraps a day in the grid. Pass date and month as DateValue instances. |
| `Day` | `components.Day` | Renders the day control using its enclosing Cell context. |
| `Grid` | `components.Grid` | Wraps the grid for a month. |
| `GridBody` | `components.GridBody` | Wraps the week rows. |
| `GridHead` | `components.GridHead` | Wraps the weekday header row. |
| `GridRow` | `components.GridRow` | Wraps a week of cells or a row of weekday headings. |
| `HeadCell` | `components.HeadCell` | Displays a weekday heading inside GridHead and GridRow. |
| `Header` | `components.Header` | Wraps the month heading and caption. |
| `Heading` | `components.Heading` | Reads the calendar context for its heading. |
| `Month` | `components.Month` | Wraps one month’s header and grid. |
| `Months` | `components.Months` | Wraps the rendered months and navigation. |
| `MonthSelect` | `components.MonthSelect` | Displays the month selector. Pass the current month number as value. |
| `Nav` | `components.Nav` | Wraps the next and previous month controls. |
| `NextButton` | `components.NextButton` | Advances the calendar. The default variant is ghost. |
| `PrevButton` | `components.PrevButton` | Moves the calendar backward. The default variant is ghost. |
| `YearSelect` | `components.YearSelect` | Displays the year selector. Pass the year number as value. |

## Native types and composition

In Svelte, use `ComponentProps<typeof components.Caption>` for the native prop type. Snippets, function props, DOM refs, and bindings follow the native types.
